summary: Music is serendipity #satchat opened up with drums and finished with "Turn on Your Love Life" perfect timing (Love Life quit loading) serendipitous time overlapping shores of collapsing walls and context symphony of sounds seaping into ephermal thought #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Music is serendipity #satchat opened up with drums and finished with "Turn on Your Love Life" perfect timing (Love Life quit loading)
serendipitous time
overlapping shores of
collapsing
walls and
context
symphony of sounds seaping
into ephermal
thought
#smallpoems
